SKILL AUTHORING & GOVERNANCE FRAMEWORK
01 / SPECIFICATION
Standardized SKILL.md

Every skill encapsulates YAML frontmatter (name, trigger, version, tags) with rigorous step-by-step procedures, references, and validation scripts.

02 / PROVENANCE
Triple Provenance

Maintained via upstream adaptation (UPSTREAM_MANIFEST.md), seat projection (PROJECTION_MANIFEST.json), and operational runbook capture.

03 / VERIFICATION
Curator Hygiene Gate

Automated curator sweeps eliminate stale instructions, enforce Rule 0 gates, and audit live tool usage across all agent seats.
